failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of carbon tetrachloride exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 30°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure
Install inline filter upstream of BPR

failure_modes.cause: Fouling on reactor walls reducing light penetration

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
validation_experiments: Run blank solvent at Q=0.29766 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Test BPR valve with particulate-laden solvent to assess blockage risk
Conduct light penetration test with fouled reactor walls to evaluate photon delivery
